dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: You get what you pay for. Do you think the work I do is the same as everyone else's?

dialogues.speaker: Harim
dialogues.text: Doing things differently from others doesn't mean your work is worth more.

dialogues.speaker: Harim
dialogues.text: Besides, everyone can learn masonry from the Akasha. What makes you so different?

dialogues.speaker: Harim
dialogues.text: If it weren't for the fact that we're old pals, I wouldn't be going out of my way to make sure you're getting business.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: The knowledge foundation might be the same, sure, but what gets built on it is different!

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Unlike other people, I'm an innovator! I've also tried more kinds of clay...

dialogues.speaker: Harim
dialogues.text: Aha! Caught ya! And you said you weren't asking me for more money because you wanted to buy new materials!
